tool.name: ParaFEM Steady-State Thermal Solver
tool.description: Solve 3D steady-state heat conduction using ParaFEM p123 (PCG solver)
tool.command: mkdir -p run && cd run && cp '$dat_file' job.dat && cp '$d_file' job.d && cp '$bnd_file' job.bnd && cp '$fix_file' job.fix && mpirun -np ${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} p123 job 2>&1 && mv job.res '$output_res' && tar czf '$output_ensi' job.ensi.*

param.name: dat_file
param.label: Control data (.dat)
param.help: Solver control parameters from BC generator

param.name: d_file
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: Mesh file with nodal coordinates and element connectivity

param.name: fix_file
param.label: Fixed freedoms (.fix)
param.help: Prescribed temperature values from BC generator

tool.help:
Solves 3D steady-state heat conduction (Laplace's equation) using ParaFEM program p123.
Solver: Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (PCG) with diagonal preconditioner, element-by-element assembly. Uses 8-node hexahedral elements.
Boundary conditions: Dirichlet (fixed temperature) via the penalty method. Nodes not in the .bnd file have natural zero-flux (insulated) BCs.
Outputs: - .res: text summary with convergence info and sample potentials/temperatures - .ensi.tar.gz: EnSight Gold scalar field (NDPTL) for ParaView visualization
The number of MPI processes is controlled by GALAXY_SLOTS.
